fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: General dentistry is where most people’s relationship with a dentist lives. It covers the regular examination that catches things early, and the treatments that deal with problems once they arrive. It includes all of our preventative care - the cleans, gum care and protection that keep problems away in the first place.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What it costs, before it starts

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Every treatment plan we give you carries its price, its inclusions and any conditions in writing before you agree to anything.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Bring your card and we claim through HICAPS at the desk, so you only pay the gap. All funds welcome, including HCF, Bupa, Medibank, nib, CBHS, Teachers Health, Defence Health, Australian Unity and GMHBA.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: First visit with us? Exam, treatment plan, X-rays, scale and clean and fluoride are no-gap where your fund rebates $199 or more, or a flat $199 without cover. New patients only; a $50 booking deposit applies and comes off the visit.
